==About==

A {{i|Dehydrated Crowberry}} is received when Dehydrating a {{i|Crowberry Stalk}} for 1 hour in a {{i|Steam Distiller}}. A Dehydrated Crowberry will disappear if not removed from your Steam Distiller within 30 minutes. A Dehydrated Crowberry can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
